issues.title: Headrest covers too dark and grey: in the photos they read lighter than the backs, in the render they merge with them
issues.evidence: Covers, q16 against y_47301 at matched positions: render #394059 / #384059 / #31384f, L50 66 / 66 / 57. Photo #40466b / #5d6a8d / #404975, L50 71 / 104 / 67. y_47306 right cover #475273, L50 79. Photo B/R 1.65-1.7 vs render 1.5-1.56. Cover vs back fabric: photo 1.25-1.7x, render about 1.0. The mid rows in far_cmp.png lose the grey-cover rhythm. Only y_47300, which is backlit, shows a dark cover (#1e243c), and w5 tuned to that photo.
issues.fix: SEATMAT.yCover in 09_seats.js: c '#474c5e' -> '#535b7c', with r 0.45 -> 0.38 for the satin sheen seen in y_47303 / 47306. It feeds econUnitFar too. Re-measure: q16 cover L50 should be 70-85 and B/R about 1.65.

issues.title: Dash mosaic laid out as a diagonal zigzag of clumps, not the photo's rectilinear brick checker of fine dashes
issues.evidence: tex_y_mosaic.png: dense dash clusters sit on offset diagonal rows and read as chevrons in q15 seat 2 (mosaic_cmp.png). In y_47306 right back and the y_47300 pans, cells are axis-aligned rectangles (~1.6 x 2.2 cm) in staggered columns, filled with thin horizontal dashes. Blob analysis at matched 2.3 mm/px (y_47306 downsampled): photo 7.7k blobs/m2, median 0.20 cm2; render 4.3k/m2, median 0.41 cm2. The render blobs are about twice as large and half as many.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_mosaic(): place dense/sparse cells on an axis-aligned grid, cells ~0.016 m wide x 0.022 m tall, each row of cells shifted half a cell (brick), no diagonal offset. Dashes 1.5-2 px tall, length 0.4-0.9 of cell width, a 1 px gap at cell borders so the column seams show. Keep 42 % dense-cell cover and the current base #56638b. Target at q15: blob median about 0.2 cm2, light fraction about 0.3.

issues.title: Diamond fabric overcorrected: low-contrast fuzzy blobs with no bright speck layer and no serrated figure edges
issues.evidence: e4b diamond back: p90/p50 1.37, ratio 1.57, p90 L 100. y_47306 left: 2.11 / 2.16 / 207. y_47302 middle: 2.25 / 2.67 / 166. Otsu light fraction 0.49 against 0.14-0.22. The photo figures are stepped, jagged diamonds, which read as made of light dash runs; the render figures are soft, round-cornered clouds (diamond_cmp.png).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_diamond(): darken the ground to the mosaic base level. Build each figure from horizontal 1-2 px dash runs whose length follows a stepped diamond, so the edges are serrated. Raise bright specks from 1.2 % to ~8 % of pixels, at lift ~3.0 (not 2.2), concentrated inside the figures. Target light fraction 0.15-0.22, ratio >= 2.0, p90/p50 >= 1.9.

issues.title: Pillow still a soft rounded rectangle, no bow-tie pinch
issues.evidence: y_47300 (p00_arm.png crop): all four pillows have pointed, pulled-out corners, concave edges and a centre dimple. e4b_pillow / e7_arm show rounded corners and straight sides.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js pillow vertex loop: after the superellipse squash, scale X and Z by (1 + 0.15*|sx*sz|) to pull the corners out and pinch the edges, and multiply the depth by (1 - 0.25*exp(-(sx^2+sz^2)/0.08)) for the dimple.

issues.title: Seat-pocket net still reads as a bar grille with light hem rolls
issues.evidence: e6_lowback: 2.5 mm strands on cells about 20 x 17 mm. sans_20 shows a fine net with ~5 mm cells, see-through to the contents, and dark-grey pleated hems (render hems #7b7e85, too light).
issues.fix: Replace the 8+4 gBox strands per pouch with one bowed gQuad using LAYER.grille (or a net atlas cell) at a ~5 mm pitch over the dark backing #121316. Hem colour #4a4c52.

issues.title: Screen chin flat jet black; no lighter frame ring round the glass
issues.evidence: q18 chin #16161c, L50 15, p90/p50 1.01. y_47305 chin #1d1926, L50 27, with a ~4 mm lighter grey frame (#4f576d) between bezel and shell.
issues.fix: SEATMAT.bezel c -> '#2a2932' (r 0.12). Add a gRBox ring 0.006 wide in '#5a6072' (r 0.35) behind the bezel quad in the econSeat screen block.

issues.title: Fabric order in the paired q15 row does not match y_47300
issues.evidence: y_47300 front row backs tick / fleck / tick / fleck (L50 90 / 52 / 69 / 47), with the dash mosaic on the pans. In q15 the same seats show diamond / mosaic / tick / fleck. The mix rule is plausible across the cabin (y_47302 / 47306), but the paired view invites a direct mismatch.
issues.fix: Pick the `rot` / k offset in econFab for the row shown in q15 so it yields [yFabric, yFabricD, yFabric, yFabricD] across that 4-block, or special-case that row in 05_layout via opts.rot.

issues.title: Cover hem band and logo corner do not read
issues.evidence: y_47306: a stitched hem band ~10 % of cover height across the bottom, with a small ANA mark at its right. The render stitch quad is at y 0.592, 7 mm above the 0.585 edge, and is invisible at q16 / e4.
issues.fix: Move the stitch to 0.585 + 0.02. Add a hem quad 0.255 x 0.02 at y 0.595 in '#4f5672' (r 0.35), a shade lighter and glossier than the plate.

issues.title: Missing centre strip at the back top above the headrest (headrest track cover)
issues.evidence: y_47306 right seat: a ~0.12 m wide panel in a contrasting herringbone weave runs from the pad top to the back top. y_47306 middle shows the same seam.
issues.fix: In econSeat, add a thin loftAt panel 0.12 wide, ~3 mm proud of the back front, from the pad top (0.78) to 0.85, using yFabric with a slightly lighter base.

issues.title: (For the camera owner) q15 still framed higher than y_47300
issues.evidence: q15 crops off the front-row pillows, arms and pans that dominate y_47300, so those details go unjudged in the paired view.
issues.fix: test/qa.js q15: lower the eye ~0.25 m and pitch up ~5 deg, so the front-row pans sit at the bottom edge as in y_47300.

questionsForUser: The aisle-end armrest fairing in y_47303 is an open C-loop (pad on top, lower rail, with the seat cushion visible between them), but y_47302's block end shows a fuller panel down to the floor. Do the ANA 777 Recaro seats use both, depending on row or position?
The headrest cover hangs ~19 % of its height below the pad in y_47306 but ends flush with the pad in y_47300. Is that just headrest height adjustment? Which position should be the default?
Is the contrasting centre strip at the back top (y_47306) on every seat, or only on some fabric variants?
